# Backend Specification Quality Checklist: In-App Notification System

**Purpose**: Comprehensive requirements quality review validating completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, scenario coverage, edge cases, data isolation, and audit immutability across the in-app notification specification.  
**Created**: 2026-10-09  
**Feature**: [specs/002-in-app-notifications/spec.md](../spec.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the required attributes of a notification entity (identifier, recipient, subject, body, read status, creation timestamp, read timestamp, originating entity type, originating entity identifier) fully enumerated and defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements specified for all 9 defined originating domain event triggers spanning student, teacher, and administrator lifecycles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-021, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the inbox filtering capabilities explicitly defined for all supported read status values (`All`, `Unread`, `Read`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the behavior for retrieving unread notification badge counters specified as an aggregate numeric count? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, User Story 1 §Scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are both individual and global bulk mark-as-read operations explicitly documented with their respective state transition rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007, User Story 2]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK006 - Is default pagination sizing (20 items) and maximum allowable limit (50 items) explicitly quantified with exact numeric thresholds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications 2026-10-09]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the secondary tie-breaker sort order (`id DESC`) unambiguously specified to guarantee deterministic pagination when multiple records share identical timestamps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications 2026-10-09]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the pre-rendering timing and persistence rule for static subject and message body text explicitly clarified to occur at event creation time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Clarifications 2026-10-09]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the scope of the bulk mark-all-as-read operation explicitly defined as global across the user's entire inbox rather than filtered by notification type? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Clarifications 2026-10-09]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the originating entity type constrained to a closed, unambiguous enumeration matching the 9 defined triggers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, Clarifications 2026-10-09]

## 3. Requirement Consistency & Alignment

- [ ] CHK011 - Are read status representations (`Unread` vs `Read`) consistent across entity definitions, status filtering, and mark-as-read transitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 - Do originating entity type identifiers align consistently with corresponding domain entities in the core specification (rewards, proposals, activities, points)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the prohibition on external notification delivery (SMS, email, third-party push) consistent with the global system requirements and architecture scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are notification trigger rules for reward approval and auto-approval consistent with the reward approval rules defined in the primary requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-016, User Story 3 §Scenario 1-2]

## 4. Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [ ] CHK015 - Are testable acceptance scenarios defined for verifying that unread badge counts decrement by exactly 1 upon marking an individual notification read? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 2 §Scenario 1, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the idempotency of marking an already `Read` notification as read specified with measurable invariant criteria (no timestamp modification, no count change)? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 2 §Scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK017 - Can the success criterion of zero cross-user notification leakage or tampering be objectively measured and tested? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK018 - Can the bulk mark-all-as-read operation be objectively verified to transition 100% of unread items and reset the counter to 0 regardless of inbox volume? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §FR-007]

## 5. Scenario & Lifecycle Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 - Are notification generation requirements documented for all student reward request status transitions (`Pending to Receive`, `Completed`, `Declined`)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, User Story 3 §Scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are notification generation requirements documented for voluntary task proposal approval, point modification, completion, and decline? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, User Story 3 §Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements specified for bidirectional task proposal messaging alerts (student alerts on admin messages, admin alerts on student messages)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §FR-018, User Story 3 §Scenario 4, User Story 4 §Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are notification requirements documented for teacher positive point awards and administrator manual balance adjustments? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013, User Story 3 §Scenario 5-6]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are notification requirements documented for activity verification reviews, 3-rejection submission bans, and manual unblocks? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015, User Story 3 §Scenario 7-9]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are multi-admin review alerts specified for reward requests requiring approval, new task proposals, and verification submissions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-019, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are notification generation requirements documented for administrator point pool transfers to teacher budgets? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, User Story 5]

## 6. Edge Cases & Boundary Conditions

- [ ] CHK026 - Does the spec define system behavior for newly created user accounts or inboxes with zero unread notifications (empty list, count 0, no errors)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, User Story 1 §Scenario 6]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements explicit that deactivated or departed users cease receiving new event notifications while preserving existing historical records? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is recipient filtering behavior defined to prevent self-triggered notifications (e.g., an admin posting a message does not notify themselves)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 - Does the spec define system behavior for rapid consecutive events, ensuring each generates a distinct, independent notification record? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are persistence requirements defined when an originating business entity is modified, renamed, or deleted after notification generation? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is independent inbox behavior specified for multi-admin alerts when one administrator reviews an item, leaving alerts intact in peer administrators' inboxes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 7. Security, Privacy & Data Isolation (High-Risk Gate)

- [ ] CHK032 - Is strict user isolation specified to ensure a user can never view or query notifications addressed to any other user? [Security, Isolation, Spec §FR-008, §SC-004, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are authorization rejection requirements explicitly defined when a user attempts to mark another user's notification as read by guessing or supplying an ID? [Security, Access Control, Spec §User Story 2 §Scenario 5, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is unread counter calculation strictly scoped to the authenticated caller's identity without exposure of aggregate school-wide numbers? [Privacy, Spec §FR-005, §FR-008]

## 8. Immutability, Audit & Persistence (High-Risk Gate)

- [ ] CHK035 - Is the permanent retention invariant explicitly specified, prohibiting clients and users from deleting individual or bulk notifications? [Audit Integrity, Spec §FR-003, §SC-006, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are notification deletion requests explicitly specified to be rejected by the system without data loss? [Audit Integrity, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are deep-link entity references (`originatingEntityType` and `originatingEntityId`) required to be permanently preserved on 100% of generated records? [Traceability, Spec §FR-021, §SC-002]

## 9. Non-Functional, Observability & Performance

- [ ] CHK038 - Are request correlation ID (`X-Correlation-Id`) logging and propagation requirements enforced across notification API endpoints? [Observability, Constitution §VII, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are structured JSON completion logging requirements defined for notification retrieval and read status updates? [Observability, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are semantic error response formats defined to prevent leakage of internal stack traces or database schema details? [Security, Error Handling, Constitution §VII]
